didn't pay much attention to the musicians except when he was on 52nd Street at Ryan's there was the de Paris brothers, Sidney and Wilbur de Paris and he played at Lou Terrasi's, guys would come in there to work -- Vick Dickinson, Bobby Hackett, Slam Stewart and all the guys.
Then he played at Gondon's for a long time.
